   464 |     private static string GetScriptCacheKey(GameCoordinatorAppDefinition app)
   465 |     {
   466 |         var fileIdentities = EnumerateRuntimeScriptFiles(app)
   467 |             .OrderBy(path => path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
   468 |             .Select(path =>
   469 |             {
   470 |                 var file = new FileInfo(path);
   471 |                 return string.Join(':', Path.GetRelativePath(app.RootPath, path), file.Length, file.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks);
   472 |             });
   473 | 
   474 |         return string.Join('|', new[] { app.RuntimeCacheKey }.Concat(fileIdentities));
   475 |     }
   476 | 
   477 |     private static IEnumerable<string> EnumerateRuntimeScriptFiles(GameCoordinatorAppDefinition app)
   478 |     {
   479 |         var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   480 |         if (File.Exists(app.MainScriptPath) && seen.Add(Path.GetFullPath(app.MainScriptPath)))
   481 |         {
   482 |             yield return app.MainScriptPath;
   483 |         }
   484 | 
   485 |         foreach (var directoryName in new[] { "framework", "generated", "modules" })
   486 |         {
   487 |             var directory = Path.Combine(app.RootPath, directoryName);
   488 |             if (!Directory.Exists(directory))
   489 |             {
   490 |                 continue;
   491 |             }
   492 | 
   493 |             foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "*.ts", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
   494 |                          .Where(path => !path.EndsWith(".d.ts", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
   495 |             {
   496 |                 var fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(file);
   497 |                 if (seen.Add(fullPath))
   498 |                 {
   499 |                     yield return fullPath;
   500 |                 }
   501 |             }
   502 |         }
   503 |     }

   464 |     private static string GetScriptCacheKey(GameCoordinatorAppDefinition app)
   465 |     {
   466 |         var fileIdentities = EnumerateRuntimeScriptFiles(app)
   467 |             .OrderBy(path => path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)

   165 |         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   166 |         {
   167 |             return Path.GetFullPath(configuredRoot);
   168 |         }
   169 | 
   170 |         var root = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetFullPath(contentRootPath));
   171 |         for (var current = root; current != null; current = current.Parent)
   172 |         {
   173 |             if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server.csproj")))
   174 |             {
   175 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "Data");
   176 |             }
   177 | 
   178 |             var nestedProject = Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "SKYNET server.csproj");
   179 |             if (File.Exists(nestedProject))
   180 |             {
   181 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "Data");
   182 |             }
   183 |         }
   184 | 
   185 |         return Path.Combine(root.FullName, "Data");
   186 |     }

   157 |     private static string ResolveDataRoot(string contentRootPath, IConfiguration configuration)
   158 |     {
   159 |         var configuredRoot = configuration.GetValue<string>("Data:Root")?.Trim();
   160 |         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   161 |         {
   162 |             configuredRoot = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SKYNET_DATA_ROOT")?.Trim();
   163 |         }
   164 | 
   165 |         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   166 |         {
   167 |             return Path.GetFullPath(configuredRoot);
   168 |         }
   169 | 
   170 |         var root = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetFullPath(contentRootPath));
   171 |         for (var current = root; current != null; current = current.Parent)
   172 |         {
   173 |             if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server.csproj")))
   174 |             {
   175 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "Data");
   176 |             }
   177 | 
   178 |             var nestedProject = Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "SKYNET server.csproj");
   179 |             if (File.Exists(nestedProject))
   180 |             {
   181 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "Data");
   182 |             }
   183 |         }
   184 | 
   185 |         return Path.Combine(root.FullName, "Data");
   186 |     }
   187 | }

   157 |     private static string ResolveDataRoot(string contentRootPath, IConfiguration configuration)
   158 |     {
   159 |         var configuredRoot = configuration.GetValue<string>("Data:Root")?.Trim();
   160 |         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   161 |         {
   162 |             configuredRoot = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SKYNET_DATA_ROOT")?.Trim();
   163 |         }
   164 | 
   165 |         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   166 |         {
   167 |             return Path.GetFullPath(configuredRoot);
   168 |         }
   169 | 
   170 |         var root = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetFullPath(contentRootPath));
   171 |         for (var current = root; current != null; current = current.Parent)
   172 |         {
   173 |             if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server.csproj")))
   174 |             {
   175 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "Data");
   176 |             }
   177 | 
   178 |             var nestedProject = Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "SKYNET server.csproj");
   179 |             if (File.Exists(nestedProject))
   180 |             {
   181 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "Data");
   182 |             }
   183 |         }
   184 | 
   185 |         return Path.Combine(root.FullName, "Data");
   186 |     }
   187 | }

    // SKYNET_DEADLOCK_DEDICATED_STEAMID_GUARD_V1_METHOD
    // Only a live reservation observed by this supervisor may receive
    // GCToServerAllocateForMatch (10021).
    public bool IsRegisteredDedicatedGameServer(ulong gameServerSteamId)
    {
        if (gameServerSteamId == 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        lock (_sync)
        {
            SweepLocked(DateTime.UtcNow);

            foreach (var reservation in _reservations.Values)
            {
                if (reservation.GameServerSteamId == gameServerSteamId)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public void ObserveRegistration(
        ulong gameServerSteamId,
        ApiGameServer server)
    {
        if (
            gameServerSteamId ==
                0 ||
            server ==
                null ||
            server.Port <=
                0 ||
            !server.Dedicated
        )
        {
            return;
        }

        // Accept AppId=0 during early Steamworks registration only when
        // the port is one of OUR reservations. Explicit foreign AppIDs
        // are never accepted.
        if (
            server.AppId !=
                0 &&
            server.AppId !=
                DeadlockGcRuntimeServices.AppId
        )
        {
            return;
        }

        lock (
            _sync
        )
        {
            SweepLocked(
                DateTime.UtcNow
            );

            var reservation =
                _reservations.Values.FirstOrDefault(
                    candidate =>
                        candidate.IsLive &&
                        candidate.Port ==
                            server.Port &&
                        (
                            candidate.State ==
                                DedicatedReservationState.Starting ||
                            candidate.State ==
                                DedicatedReservationState.Registered
                        )
                );

            if (
                reservation ==
                null
            )
            {
                return;
            }

            reservation.GameServerSteamId =
                gameServerSteamId;

            reservation.PublicIp =
                server.IP;

            reservation.State =
                DedicatedReservationState.Registered;

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Deadlock dedicated registered SteamID {SteamId} for lobby {LobbyId} at {Ip}:{Port}",
                gameServerSteamId,
                reservation.LobbyId,
                reservation.PublicIp,
                reservation.Port
            );
        }
    }

    public string ClaimLobby(
        ulong gameServerSteamId,
        uint reportedPort)
    {
        if (
            gameServerSteamId ==
                0 ||
            reportedPort ==
                0
        )
        {
            return "0";
        }

        lock (
            _sync
        )
        {
            SweepLocked(
                DateTime.UtcNow
            );

            foreach (
                var reservation in
                    _reservations.Values
            )
            {
                if (
                    reservation.GameServerSteamId ==
                    gameServerSteamId
                )
                {
                    reservation.State =
                        DedicatedReservationState.Claimed;

                    return reservation.LobbyId.ToString(
                        System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture
                    );
                }

                if (
                    reservation.IsLive &&
                    reservation.Port ==
                        reportedPort &&
                    (
                        reservation.State ==
                            DedicatedReservationState.Starting ||
                        reservation.State ==
                            DedicatedReservationState.Registered
                    )
                )
                {
                    reservation.GameServerSteamId =
                        gameServerSteamId;

                    reservation.State =
                        DedicatedReservationState.Claimed;

                    _logger.LogInformation(
                        "Claimed Deadlock dedicated {SteamId} for lobby {LobbyId} port {Port}",
                        gameServerSteamId,
                        reservation.LobbyId,
                        reportedPort
                    );

                    return reservation.LobbyId.ToString(
                        System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture
                    );
                }
            }

            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Rejected unreserved Deadlock dedicated {SteamId} port {Port}",
                gameServerSteamId,
                reportedPort
            );

            return "0";
        }
    }

    public bool HasReservationForPort(
        uint port)
    {
        if (
            port ==
            0
        )
        {
            return false;
        }

        lock (
            _sync
        )
        {
            SweepLocked(
                DateTime.UtcNow
            );

            return _reservations.Values.Any(
                reservation =>
                    reservation.IsLive &&
                    reservation.Port ==
                        port
            );
        }
    }

    public DedicatedReservationSnapshot GetReservation(
        ulong lobbyId)
    {
        lock (
            _sync
        )
        {
            SweepLocked(
                DateTime.UtcNow
            );

            if (
                !_reservations.TryGetValue(
                    lobbyId,
                    out var reservation
                )
            )
            {
                return DedicatedReservationSnapshot.NotFound(
                    lobbyId
                );
            }

            return new DedicatedReservationSnapshot(
                true,
                reservation.LobbyId,
                reservation.Port,
                reservation.Map,
                reservation.State,
                reservation.GameServerSteamId,
                reservation.PublicIp,
                reservation.Error
            );
        }
    }

    public string GetStatus(
        ulong lobbyId)
    {
        var snapshot =
            GetReservation(
                lobbyId
            );

        return snapshot.Found
            ? snapshot.State.ToString()
                .ToLowerInvariant()
            : "not_found";
    }

    public bool Release(
        ulong lobbyId,
        string reason)
    {
        lock (
            _sync
        )
        {
            if (
                !_reservations.Remove(
                    lobbyId,
                    out var reservation
                )
            )
            {
                return false;
            }

            StopProcess(
                reservation,
                reason
            );

            return true;
        }
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(
        CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        using var timer =
            new PeriodicTimer(
                TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
                    1
                )
            );

        try
        {
            while (
                await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(
                    stoppingToken
                )
            )
            {
                lock (
                    _sync
                )
                {
                    SweepLocked(
                        DateTime.UtcNow
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        catch (
            OperationCanceledException
        ) when (
            stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested
        )
        {
        }
    }

    public override Task StopAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        lock (
            _sync
        )
        {
            foreach (
                var reservation in
                    _reservations.Values
            )
            {
                StopProcess(
                    reservation,
                    "SKYNET server stopped"
                );
            }

            _reservations.Clear();
        }

        return base.StopAsync(
            cancellationToken
        );
    }

    private void SweepLocked(
        DateTime current)
    {
        foreach (
            var reservation in
                _reservations.Values
        )
        {
            if (
                !reservation.IsLive &&
                reservation.State !=
                    DedicatedReservationState.Failed &&
                reservation.State !=
                    DedicatedReservationState.Stopped
            )
            {
                reservation.State =
                    DedicatedReservationState.Failed;

                reservation.Error =
                    "Deadlock dedicated process exited before assignment.";

                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Deadlock dedicated lobby {LobbyId} exited before assignment. ExitCode={ExitCode}",
                    reservation.LobbyId,
                    TryGetExitCode(
                        reservation.Process
                    )
                );

                continue;
            }

            if (
                reservation.State ==
                    DedicatedReservationState.Starting &&
                current -
                    reservation.StartedAt >
                    _startupTimeout
            )
            {
                reservation.State =
                    DedicatedReservationState.Failed;

                reservation.Error =
                    "Timed out waiting for Deadlock GameServer registration.";

                StopProcess(
                    reservation,
                    reservation.Error
                );

                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Deadlock dedicated lobby {LobbyId} timed out waiting for registration",
                    reservation.LobbyId
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private int AllocatePortLocked()
    {
        for (
            var port =
                _portStart;

            port <=
                Math.Min(
                    65534,
                    _portStart +
                    256
                );

            port++
        )
        {
            if (
                _reservations.Values.Any(
                    reservation =>
                        reservation.IsLive &&
                        reservation.Port ==
                            port
                )
            )
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (
                CanBindPort(
                    port
                )
            )
            {
                return port;
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    private static bool CanBindPort(
        int port)
    {
        try
        {
            using var tcp =
                new TcpListener(
                    IPAddress.Any,
                    port
                );

            tcp.Start();

            using var udp =
                new Socket(
                    AddressFamily.InterNetwork,
                    SocketType.Dgram,
                    ProtocolType.Udp
                );

            udp.Bind(
                new IPEndPoint(
                    IPAddress.Any,
                    port
                )
            );

            return true;
        }
        catch (
            SocketException
        )
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void StopProcess(
        DedicatedReservation reservation,
        string reason)
    {
        if (
            reservation.State !=
            DedicatedReservationState.Failed
        )
        {
            reservation.State =
                DedicatedReservationState.Stopped;
        }

        try
        {
            if (
                !reservation.Process.HasExited
            )
            {
                reservation.Process.Kill(
                    entireProcessTree:
                        true
                );

                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Stopped Deadlock dedicated pid {ProcessId} lobby {LobbyId}: {Reason}",
                    reservation.Process.Id,
                    reservation.LobbyId,
                    reason
                );
            }
        }
        catch (
            InvalidOperationException
        )
        {
        }
        catch (
            Exception ex
        )
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                ex,
                "Could not stop Deadlock dedicated lobby {LobbyId}",
                reservation.LobbyId
            );
        }
    }

    private static string ResolvePath(
        string? configured,
        string contentRoot,
        string fallback)
    {
        var value =
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                configured
            )
                ? fallback
                : configured.Trim();

        return Path.GetFullPath(
            Path.IsPathRooted(
                value
            )
                ? value
                : Path.Combine(
                    contentRoot,
                    value
                )
        );
    }

    private static bool TryNormalizeIPv4(
        string value,
        out string normalized)
    {
        normalized =
            string.Empty;

        if (
            !IPAddress.TryParse(
                value,
                out var parsed
            ) ||
            parsed.AddressFamily !=
                AddressFamily.InterNetwork
        )
        {
            return false;
        }

        normalized =
            parsed.ToString();

        return true;
    }

    private static string NormalizeMap(
        string? requested,
        string fallback)
    {
        var map =
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                requested
            )
                ? fallback
                : requested.Trim();

        if (
            map.Length ==
            0
        )
        {
            return fallback;
        }

        if (
            map.Contains(
                "..",
                StringComparison.Ordinal
            )
        )
        {
            return fallback;
        }

        foreach (
            var character in
                map
        )
        {
            if (
                !char.IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(
                    character
                ) &&
                character !=
                    '_' &&
                character !=
                    '-' &&
                character !=
                    '/'
            )
            {
                return fallback;
            }
        }

        return map;
    }

    private static int? TryGetExitCode(
        Process process)
    {
        try
        {
            return process.HasExited
                ? process.ExitCode
                : null;
        }
        catch (
            InvalidOperationException
        )
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public sealed record DedicatedLaunchResult(
        bool Started,
        int Port,
        DedicatedReservationState State,
        string Error)
    {
        public static DedicatedLaunchResult Failed(
            string error)
        {
            return new DedicatedLaunchResult(
                false,
                0,
                DedicatedReservationState.Failed,
                error
            );
        }
    }

    public sealed record DedicatedReservationSnapshot(
        bool Found,
        ulong LobbyId,
        int Port,
        string Map,
        DedicatedReservationState State,
        ulong GameServerSteamId,
        uint PublicIp,
        string Error)
    {
        public static DedicatedReservationSnapshot NotFound(
            ulong lobbyId)
        {
            return new DedicatedReservationSnapshot(
                false,
                lobbyId,
                0,
                string.Empty,
                DedicatedReservationState.Stopped,
                0,
                0,
                string.Empty
            );
        }
    }

    public enum DedicatedReservationState
    {
        Starting,
        Registered,
        Claimed,
        Failed,
        Stopped
    }

    private sealed class DedicatedReservation
    {
        public DedicatedReservation(
            ulong lobbyId,
            int port,
            string map,
            Process process,
            DateTime startedAt)
        {
            LobbyId =
                lobbyId;

            Port =
                port;

            Map =
                map;

            Process =
                process;

            StartedAt =
                startedAt;
        }

        public ulong LobbyId
        {
            get;
        }

        public int Port
        {
            get;
        }

        public string Map
        {
            get;
        }

        public Process Process
        {
            get;
        }

        public DateTime StartedAt
        {
            get;
        }

        public ulong GameServerSteamId
        {
            get;
            set;
        }

        public uint PublicIp
        {
            get;
            set;
        }

        public DedicatedReservationState State
        {
            get;
            set;
        } =
            DedicatedReservationState.Starting;

        public string Error
        {
            get;
            set;
        } =
            string.Empty;

        public bool IsLive
        {
            get
            {
                try
                {
                    return !Process.HasExited;
                }
                catch (
                    InvalidOperationException
                )
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/*
 * Deadlock 1422450
 *
 * RAW GameServer pre-dispatch:
 *
 *   10014 CMsgServerToGCMatchSignout
 *      ->
 *   10015 CMsgServerToGCMatchSignoutResponse
 *
 * Current protobuf:
 *
 * message CMsgServerToGCMatchSignoutResponse {
 *     enum ESignoutResult {
 *         k_ESignout_Failed_Retry = 1;
 *         k_ESignout_Failed_NoRetry = 2;
 *         k_ESignout_Failed_InFlight = 3;
 *         k_ESignout_Success = 4;
 *         k_ESignout_Success_AlreadySignedOut = 5;
 *     }
 *
 *     optional ESignoutResult result = 1;
 * }
 *
 * Minimal successful protobuf:
 *
 *   field 1 / varint / value 4
 *   08 04
 *
 * Base64:
 *   CAQ=
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 * 10014 is intentionally NOT decoded or persisted in V1.
 * This experiment only completes the GameServer signout handshake.
 */

export function requestDeadlockMatchSignoutRaw(): boolean {
    if (
        messageType() !=
        10014
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    log(
        "[10014-GS] RAW MatchSignout received"
    );

    /*
     * CMsgServerToGCMatchSignoutResponse
     *
     * result = k_ESignout_Success
     *
     * field 1 = 4
     *
     * protobuf:
     *   08 04
     */
    const response = [
        8,
        4
    ];

    reply(
        10015,
        response,
        true
    );

    log(
        "[10014-GS] replied 10015 result=Success(4) bytes=2"
    );

    return true;
}
